Battle & Map Stats — shot journal + per-map statistics

previous.changeLog: Исправлен деинсталлятор: теперь удаляет старые wotmod с опечаточными именами (net.battle_map_stat_*.wotmod без конечной s), которые раньше не очищались и вызывали конфликт пакетов («Package ignored due to conflict»). Ранее после удаления мода через деинсталлятор в папке mods/ оставался конфликтующий файл от старой версии, из-за чего игра могла не запускаться.

current.changeLog:
(v1.0.7)
Добавлено
Кнопка «глаз» для сворачивания/разворачивания панели — в обеих панелях (журнал попаданий и статистика карт). При сворачивании панель превращается в маленький значок, при нажатии — разворачивается обратно.
Убрано
Настройки showInHangar, showInBattle, toggleKey — больше не нужны. Панели работают в ангаре и в бою, управление сворачиванием через кнопку «глаз» и клавишу Esc.
Исправлено
Ошибка NaN при вычислении размера viewport — applySize(w, h) теперь корректно получает размер панели.
Улучшено
Качество шрифтов — добавлены antialiased, optimizeLegibility, letter-spacing для более чёткого отображения текста.

- Fixed the constant right-and-down offset of drawings relative to the standard minimap.
- The overlay now uses the current minimap size correctly when entering battle and after the size is changed.
- Fixed arrowheads and perpendicular end markers on freehand strokes.
- Dashed and dotted styles now render continuously and evenly across freehand paths and circles.

previous.changeLog: Fixed vanilla camouflage, emblems, and inscriptions reappearing after removal. - Fixed custom outfits displaying differently between the garage and battle. - Improved transitions from 3D styles to custom 2D customization. - Preserved the server-outfit authorization requirement without merging its appearance.

current.changeLog: Improved compatibility between 3D styles and custom decals, emblems, and inscriptions. Custom overlays are now preserved when replacing a 3D style with 2D customization, and compatible unowned 3D styles can be used locally. Added optional descriptions for custom assets and improved support for branded vehicles such as the Rheinmetall Skorpion G. Also fixed invalid styles, errors when entering Custom mode from certain 3D styles, and unnecessary error reports caused by shared-battle connection timeouts.

previous.changeLog:
NEW
- Circle-colour pickers in the settings menu: the four state colours (moving / still / after firing / camo net) are now editable from the in-garage configurator (a mods-settings menu such as aslainMenu / ModsSettingsAPI) with real colour pickers, instead of hand-editing decimal RGB values in spotmeter.json. The section tooltip reminds you that XVM's minimap, while active, repaints the circle in its own colour and overrides these.
CHANGED
- Rebuilt for WoT 2.3.1.2 (minor patch; no other gameplay changes).
Reminder (since v7.0.0): the in-battle panel is a Gameface overlay and REQUIRES net.openwg.gameface (free, MIT; already in common modpacks). The minimap circle and the hotkeys work even without it.
